blurb: Humble Sea Brewing Company brews a range of beers from experimental to traditional German lagers. They offer monthly beer subscription boxes delivered in California, taproom locations with food and events, and private event spaces with tasting experiences. Their philosophy embraces innovation and approachability in craft beer.
extraNote: Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled; minimum 3 boxes commitment · Cancel subscription after third box · Taproom locations: Santa Cruz, Pacifica, Alameda, San Francisco Pier 39, Felton, Santa Cruz Wharf
